notes.title: Update notes for March 6
notes.notes:
This update includes a number of bug fixes:


 Updates window settings for a smoother experience
 Fixes mouse controls for long-range attacks
 Fixes boss teleporting out of bounds during The Lab boss fight
 Fixes boss repeating the same attack repeatedly during The Field boss fight
 Adds support for Mac (official launch coming soon)

notes.title: Update notes for March 2
notes.notes:
This update includes a number of bug fixes:


 Fixes a bug where demo save files applied to the full game
 Fixes collision placement during The Fields boss fight
 Fixes collision placement during The Lab boss fight
 Fixes sprite overlap in Homestead

notes.title: Patch notes for February 29
notes.notes:
This update includes a number of bug fixes:


 Fixes a broken cutscene in The Theater
 Fixes the boss from The Dam damaging itself in phase two
 Fixes looping issues in The Dam background music
 Adds dynamic music track for phase two of The City boss fight
 Fixes hitbox bug on The Theater boss fight
 Fixes a typo in The Mine
